description: Slow, drawn-out Reese bass notes over a four-chord A minor bass line at 174 BPM, the usual drum and bass tempo.
Hold one key and the built-in step sequencer plays an acid line with this sound.
A rave style hook in C minor played high on the Scream Lead sound, ending on a long held top note.
Hold a chord and the built-in arpeggiator plays it with the Siren sound.
A rolling D minor bass line at 174 BPM with short ghost notes between the longer ones.
Deep sub bass line at 174 BPM that moves between three low notes.
